title: Gravity - John Mayer (Continuum, 2006)
notes: AI interpretation from general knowledge of the record, not from listening: Strat into a Two-Rock/Dumble-style amp at the edge of breakup, a Tube Screamer for the solo, generous reverb and very little delay. Use the neck or neck+middle pickup. Tempo not verified, so delay times are moderate. Tweak gain and treble to your guitar.

patches.name: GRAV CLEAN
patches.notes: Intro and verses: gently compressed Two-Rock just below breakup, lush reverb, a faint delay.

patches.name: GRAV RHY
patches.notes: Fuller parts and fills: the same amp pushed by a low-gain Tube Screamer for a thicker, slightly broken-up sound.

patches.name: GRAV SOLO
patches.notes: Solo: Tube Screamer with more gain into the Two-Rock, more mids for a vocal, singing lead, a little more delay; slightly louder.
